exact_batch_first_passage_optimization.recurrence: H_t = Q @ H_(t-1), then set diag(H_t)=1 for t=1..70
exact_batch_first_passage_optimization.semantics: H_t[s,j] is cumulative first-passage support for target j from unit source s under the same sub-stochastic transition operator
exact_batch_first_passage_optimization.multiple_source_support: equal-weight mean of source rows with source-node columns set to 1.0 at every step
exact_batch_first_passage_optimization.compatibility_target_rule: every non-source occurrence target must have equal-weight final-step support > 0

response_endpoint_payload.unit: retained stable raw camera location x ever-recorded Capreolus capreolus detection during frozen eligible raw deployment effort
response_endpoint_payload.ever_detection: any exact focal scientificName row linked to an eligible raw deployment at the stable location

split_payload.fold_rule: 1 + (big-endian integer from first 8 bytes of SHA-256(UTF-8 locationID) modulo 5)

external_feature_payload.numeric_preprocessing: required numeric passthrough; optional camera_height calibration-median plus missing indicator
external_feature_payload.categorical_preprocessing: calibration-only lexicographic one-hot levels after __MISSING__ normalization plus per-field __UNSEEN__ indicator

placebo_payload.permutation: within each outer fold, independently per real Layer-B column, separately for calibration and heldout rows, using numpy.random.default_rng(seed)
